verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships an official MCP server enabling AI assistants (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code) to interact with and manage a PagerDuty account via natural-language commands, plus an Anthropic Claude Connector and PagerDuty Advance/SRE Agent conversational capabilities for incidents and insights. This directly satisfies natural-language operation for AI-native users, well documented across first-party sources.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming real-world reliability of NL command execution via MCP, and no third-party review validating the experience.
